cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — swimming breaststroke; a stone bridge over a town canal with lamp posts and boats passing below — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing; overgrown jungle temple ruins — sitting on the ground; a Roman marble bath hall — standing; an art or pottery studio of easels — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a coin laundromat late at night — standing; a quiet memorial hall aboard a starship — holds a few lit incense sticks in both hands before her; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — lying on her front; a pilot ready room beside a hangar — shakes a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by her ear to hear how much wine is left; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — holds a cup at chest height; a mirrored labyrinth of endless reflections and soft coloured light — standing; a forest trail junction with a wooden marker — standing
